name: Breeding With Technology
description:
The Crop Breeder is a single-block machine that allows you to breed new crops deterministically. It will consume the parent seeds, some §2Enriched Fertilizer§r and a catalyst item for material-based crops.

The stats of an offspring created by the breeder will always be the rounded down average of seeds that were consumed to create it. [note]Breeding two or more maxed-out crops will always give a maxed-out offspring.[/note]

The §2Enriched Fertilizer§r cost is 144L per tier of the offspring crop + 72L for each stat point on the new seed. So a 31/31/31 tier 5 offspring would cost roughly 7.4KL to breed.

Some crops require a minimum machine tier to be bred:
- Iridine, Osmianth and Stargatium are all §5IV§r recipes
- Titania is §5EV§r
- Bauxia is §5MV§r
- An §5HV§r machine is required to breed 31/31/31

[note]Success chance starts at 40% and increases by 10% for every tier past §5LV§r, meaning that at §5ZPM§r, it's guaranteed. A failed breed will void the parent seeds used.[/note]

As a final note: when two crops share breeding requirements (ie Tearstalks and Evil Ore), be careful to insert the seeds in the proper order as to not trigger the mutation with fewer parents.

§r§oYou only need one of the machines for this quest.
